items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So Kirby, he hired me on the spot right then.

ctx.x: "No, you go in," she said. "I think I'll go home." I remember distinctly, you know. So she says, "Oh, yes, Kirby's in there." So she said, "Well, you go ahead. I'm going home."

So I went in the Onyx Club and talked to Kirby, you know, not actually looking for a job, you know. I wanted to hear his band because they used to broadcast and I used to hear him on the radio, so I wanted to see it. So I went in. So Kirby said to me -- Maxine is getting ready to go on, so he said, "Why don't you come on and play Maxine's music." So Pete Brown was the alto player, so I took -- it was all right with Pete. You know, in those days you'd sit in. So I was just sitting in. So he loaned me his horn and…
